Accounts offers the new **editor** role (pipeline PR "Add an editor role"): in the role select for someone on the team ("Editor: also edits every post in review or live") and in the invitation form, between Member and Admin. Editors count as team.

Merge after the pipeline PR, which accepts the role. Build clean.
